\# Removes the source type property from Stripe balance payment methods

\## What’s new

Removes the \`source\_type\` property from API resources that reference a Payment Method with a \[type\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/object.md?api-version=2026-03-25.preview#payment\_method\_object-type) of \`stripe\_balance\`.

The \`source\_type\` property can appear in different hashes, depending on the resource. For example, in the Payment Record object, the removed property is \[payment\_method\_details.stripe\_balance.source\_type\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-record/object.md?api-version=2026-02-25.preview#payment\_record\_object-payment\_method\_details-stripe\_balance-source\_type), and in the create \`/v1/payment\_methods\` method, the removed parameter is \[stripe\_balance.source\_type\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods/create.md?api-version=2026-02-25.preview#create\_payment\_method-stripe\_balance-source\_type).

\## Why is this a breaking change?

Stripe balance payment methods no longer support the \`source\_type\` property. If your integration references the \`source\_type\` property for Stripe balance payments, you must remove it from your code.

\- Requests that include the \`source\_type\` parameter for Stripe balance payments now fail with a \`parameter\_unknown\` error.
\- Responses and objects for Stripe balance payments no longer include the \`source\_type\` property.

\## Impact

This change only affects integrations using \[Stripe balance payments\](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/pay-with-balance.md). It removes the \`source\_type\` property from the following resources when they represent Stripe balance payments:

\- \[Charges\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges.md?api-version=2026-03-25.preview)
\- \[Confirmation Tokens\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/confirmation\_tokens.md?api-version=2026-03-25.preview)
\- \[Payment Attempt Records\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-attempt-record.md?api-version=2026-03-25.preview)
\- \[Payment Intents\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_intents.md?api-version=2026-03-25.preview)
\- \[Payment Methods\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment\_methods.md?api-version=2026-03-25.preview)
\- \[Payment Records\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-record.md?api-version=2026-03-25.preview)
\- \[Setup Intents\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup\_intents.md?api-version=2026-03-25.preview)

You can no longer include the \`source\_type\` parameter when calling any endpoints of the affected resources for a Stripe balance payment. You can no longer reference the \`source\_type\` property in objects or responses of the affected resources when they’re associated with a Stripe balance payment.

No action is needed if you don’t use the \`stripe\_balance\` payment method.

\## Upgrade

\#### REST API

1\. \[View your current API version\](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2\. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
 \- If you don’t use an SDK, update your \[API requests\](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include \`Stripe-Version: 2026-03-25.preview\`
3\. Upgrade the API version used for \[webhook endpoints\](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4\. \[Test your integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5\. If you use Connect, \[test your Connect integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about \[Stripe API upgrades\](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).

entries.title: Removes the source type property from Stripe balance payment methods
entries.quote: Removes the `source_type` property from API resources that reference a Payment Method with a type of `stripe_balance`. The `source_type` property can appear in different hashes, depending on the resource. For example, in the Payment Record object, the removed property is payment_method_details.stripe_balance.source_type, and in the create `/v1/payment_methods` method, the removed parameter is stripe_balance.source_type.
